_appid: Skip Steam: the only FINAL FANTASY IX on Steam is appid 377840, the 2016 remaster with re-rendered character models, boosters and its own launcher. That is a different product and it is the other Lutris slug (final-fantasy-ix--1); this entry is the 2000 PlayStation original, which was never sold on Steam.
description: Final Fantasy IX (PSX 2000 USA, via RetroArch / SwanStation)
long: Final Fantasy IX is Squaresoft's deliberate return to the series' medieval-fantasy roots after the science-fiction turn of VII and VIII. The thief Zidane and his Tantalus troupe kidnap Princess Garnet of Alexandria, only to find she wanted to escape; the abduction unravels into a war driven by Queen Brahne's sudden appetite for conquest and by Kuja, the arms dealer feeding it. Four discs of pre-rendered backgrounds carry a party of eight, each locked to a class - thief, black mage, knight, white mage, summoner, dragon knight - who learn abilities out of the equipment they wear and keep them permanently once the AP is paid. Battles are ATB with up to four characters, Trance replaces the limit-break meter, and the world is dense with optional systems: Chocobo Hot and Cold treasure hunting, the Tetra Master card game, moogle mail, and synthesis shops.
name: Final Fantasy IX
short: Squaresoft's return to medieval fantasy: a thief, a runaway princess and a war over summoned magic, across four discs of ATB battles and class-locked ability learning.
